name: gmo-onair
description: GMO ONAiR - 統合業務管理システム

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,daily,equipment,server -c blue,yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w client-daily" "npm run dev -w client-equipment" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n client,equipment,techops,live,daily,server -c blue,cyan,magenta,red,yellow,green "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w client-equipment" "npm run dev -w client-techops" "npm run dev -w client-live" "npm run dev -w client-daily" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.typecheck: concurrently -m 3 -n client,daily,equipment "npx tsc -b client" "npx tsc -b client-daily" "npx tsc -b client-equipment" && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.typecheck:all: concurrently -m 4 -n client,equipment,techops,live,daily "npx tsc -b client" "npx tsc -b client-equipment" "npx tsc -b client-techops" "npx tsc -b client-live" "npx tsc -b client-daily" && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w client-daily && npm run build -w client-equipment && npm run build -w server
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w client-equipment && npm run build -w client-techops && npm run build -w client-live && npm run build -w client-daily && npm run build -w server
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-changelog.mjs && node scripts/check-fonts-vendored.mjs && node scripts/check-tokens.mjs && node scripts/check-shared-wiring.mjs && node scripts/check-file-size.mjs && node scripts/check-ui-tokens.mjs && node scripts/check-mobile-declared.mjs && node scripts/check-env-passthrough.mjs && node scripts/check-links.mjs && node scripts/check-contrast-tokens.mjs && node scripts/check-md-links.mjs && node scripts/check-migration-numbers.mjs && eslint .
